name: full-stack-design-system
description: Full Stack DS — a falsifiable claim about contract-governed compositional systems

scripts.build:all: pnpm --recursive --sort --filter '!full-stack-design-system' run build && pnpm run build
scripts.generate: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/cli.js
scripts.generate:all: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/cli.js --target=all
scripts.generate:react-native: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/cli.js --target=react-native
scripts.generate:validate: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/cli.js --validate
scripts.generate:check: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/cli.js --validate --check-semantics
scripts.generate:validate-usage: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/cli.js --validate --check-usage
scripts.generate:dry-run: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/cli.js --dry-run
scripts.generate:all:dry-run: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/cli.js --target=all --dry-run
scripts.generate:watch: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/cli.js --watch
scripts.validate:generated: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/validation/validate-cli.js
scripts.validate:generated:react-native: echo "React Native is part of the default rail: use pnpm run governed:rail (all targets) or governed:rail:react-native (targeted) so validation runs against a fresh emission manifest." && exit 1
scripts.governed:rail: pnpm run generate:check && pnpm run generate -- --target=all && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/validation/validate-cli.js --require-artifact-manifest
scripts.governed:rail:changed: pnpm run generate:check && pnpm run generate -- --target=all && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/validation/validate-cli.js --require-artifact-manifest --scope-to-git-range origin/main...HEAD
scripts.governed:rail:react-native: pnpm run generate:check && pnpm run generate:react-native && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/validation/validate-cli.js --require-artifact-manifest --framework=react-native
scripts.governed:rail:react-native:changed: pnpm run generate:check && pnpm run generate:react-native && node packages/ds-codegen/dist/validation/validate-cli.js --require-artifact-manifest --framework=react-native --scope-to-git-range origin/main...HEAD
scripts.tokens:build:check: pnpm run tokens:build && git diff --exit-code packages/ds-tokens/generated
scripts.test:frameworks: pnpm run test:vue && pnpm run test:lit && pnpm run test:svelte && pnpm run test:angular && pnpm run test:react-native
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run test:coverage:react && pnpm run test:coverage:codegen && pnpm run test:coverage:figma-plugin && pnpm run test:coverage:tokens && pnpm run test:coverage:showcase && pnpm run test:coverage:vue && pnpm run test:coverage:svelte && pnpm run test:coverage:lit && pnpm run test:coverage:angular && pnpm run test:coverage:react-native
scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:vue && pnpm run typecheck:angular && pnpm run typecheck:lit && pnpm run typecheck:svelte && pnpm run typecheck:react-native && pnpm run typecheck:figma
scripts.audit:behavior-realization: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node scripts/behavior-realization-audit/realization.test.mjs && node scripts/behavior-realization-audit/audit.mjs
scripts.audit:a11y-realization: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node scripts/a11y-realization-audit/selfcheck.mjs && node scripts/a11y-realization-audit/audit.mjs
scripts.audit:custom-regions: node scripts/lib/ledger-ratchet.test.mjs && node scripts/custom-region-audit/selfcheck.mjs && node scripts/custom-region-audit/audit.mjs
scripts.audit:motion-realization: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node scripts/lib/ledger-ratchet.test.mjs && node scripts/motion-realization-audit/selfcheck.mjs && node scripts/motion-realization-audit/audit.mjs
scripts.audit:carrier-reachability: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node scripts/lib/ledger-ratchet.test.mjs && pnpm exec vitest run packages/ds-codegen/src/carrier-reachability.test.ts && node scripts/carrier-reachability-audit/audit.mjs
scripts.audit:variant-realization: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@full-stack-ds/codegen && node scripts/lib/ledger-ratchet.test.mjs && node scripts/variant-style-audit/realization.test.mjs && node scripts/variant-style-audit/audit.mjs
scripts.parity:compose-tokens: pnpm --filter @full-stack-ds/codegen build && node --test scripts/compose-parity-diff.test.mjs && node scripts/compose-parity-diff.mjs
